propositions: bridge_fsck reads prev_snapshot.json as an offline Jira oracle and passes field values to ObservedJira.PRESENT for drift classification, making it an out-of-band consumer not exercised by reconcile_once tests.

When prev_snapshot is narrowed to a key-set fixture with empty dict entries ({jira_key: {}}), field-based classification silently degrades and falsely reports would_terminal drift instead of indeterminate status.

Field-value-dependent classifications must report indeterminate rather than inferring from absent fields; membership-only checks (active-bound, missing-local, unbound-present) remain sufficient and must behave identically to full-payload fixtures.
bridge_fsck must not emit false would_terminal drift classifications or failing exit codes (exit 1) when operating against key-set prev_snapshot fixtures.

Full-payload prev_snapshot behavior and JSON envelope shape must remain byte-identical to baseline; rebar bridge-fsck exit codes and JSON output must be unchanged for both full-payload and key-set fixtures.
